changes: Removed the configured 32-person call ceiling. Usable media capacity still depends on devices, relay capacity and server resources.
Fixed queued refreshes so membership, channel and content actions wait for current data.
Post saves now persist content and visibility policy before waiting for one final refresh, keeping retries tied to the created post.
Restored live updates by fixing event-stream negotiation with Gravitas.
Fixed public comments and reactions when a previously saved private post is published.
Added production-account integration coverage and documented the remaining device, network, load and accessibility checks.
